description: This file defines classes and functions for processing and rendering documentation, including classes for Documentation, Class, Member, and Type, as well as functions for parsing type expressions, processing code groups, and patching links within documentation nodes.

classes.name: Documentation
classes.description: Main class for managing a collection of documented classes, supporting merging, filtering, link rendering, and source code comment generation.

classes.name: Class
classes.description: Represents a documented class with members, properties, methods, events, and associated metadata.

classes.name: Member
classes.description: Represents a class member such as a method, property, or event, with support for filtering, cloning, and visiting.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Represents a data type with parsing, cloning, and filtering capabilities, supporting complex type expressions.

methods.name: mergeWith
methods.description: Merges the current Documentation instance with another, combining class collections.

methods.name: copyDocsFromSuperclasses
methods.description: Copies documentation from superclasses, appending members and checking for overrides.

methods.name: filterForLanguage
methods.description: Filters classes and members based on the specified programming language.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes classes and their members for quick lookup.

methods.name: setLinkRenderer
methods.description: Sets a custom link renderer and patches links within documentation nodes.

methods.name: renderLinksInNodes
methods.description: Replaces link placeholders in documentation nodes with actual links.

methods.name: renderLinksInText
methods.description: Replaces link placeholders within a text string.

methods.name: setCodeGroupsTransformer
methods.description: Sets a transformer for processing code groups in documentation.

methods.name: generateSourceCodeComments
methods.description: Generates source code comments for all classes and members.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Documentation instance.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes class members for quick access.

methods.name: filterForLanguage
methods.description: Filters class members based on language.

methods.name: sortMembers
methods.description: Sorts class members by kind and alias.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Visits class and its members with a provided callback.
